messages.text:
The reference is the Windows build, so the Python port should match Windows-style metadata such as `-a---`/`d----` and the CRLF-normalized fixture expectations.

I’m narrowing the implementation to the benchmark surface: path parsing, hidden filtering, sorting, one-line/grid/tree, symlinks, and long columns with colors/icons off.
